paperInfo.subject: Business Studies
paperInfo.copyrightNote: Original practice questions synthesized from syllabus structure and recurring examination themes; not verbatim copies of copyrighted past papers.
paperInfo.sourceBasis: ZIMSEC Business Studies 6025/1/2 syllabus/specimen and examination structure.

questions.questionText: Case study: A Zimbabwean business is considering a major decision involving business objectives. Explain the issue, identify relevant internal and external factors, and evaluate two possible courses of action. Conclude with a justified recommendation for the business.
questions.explanation: A strong response should define the issue, apply relevant business concepts to the case, analyse benefits and costs of alternatives, consider stakeholders and justify a conclusion.
